title: Render validation test
description: A test component with typed and format-constrained fields covering all JSON Schema format keywords, a pattern-constrained date field, a nested link object, and an unconstrained rich text field.

label.title: Label
label.description: Plain string field with no format constraint.

date_pattern.title: Date (ISO 8601)
date_pattern.description: String field with an ISO 8601 date regex pattern constraint.

link.title: Link
link.description: Nested object field with a URI-constrained href and an unconstrained text label.

text.title: Link text
text.description: Plain string field with no format constraint.

rich_text.title: Rich text
rich_text.description: Plain string field with no format or pattern constraint.

rich_text_html.title: Rich text (HTML format)
rich_text_html.description: String field with format: html for HTML-rich token replacement coverage.
